title: Graph Connectivity With Threshold
goal: Answer which city pairs are connected through links sharing a divisor greater than the threshold.
strategy: For each divisor above the threshold, union it with all of its multiples. Those unions represent every qualifying common-divisor link and automatically capture paths through intermediate cities.
